title: Riot Squad | PUNX | Guava Passion Fruit Pineapple 60ml
description:
Riot Squad | PUNX | Guava Passion Fruit Pineapple 60ml
The Punx range is from renowned UK e-liquid brand Riot Squad, with this collection dedicated to layered fruit combinations with a punk theme.
Experience a tropical paradise with every puff when you try the Riot Squad Punx Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple 60ml E-Liquid. This unique blend combines the sweet, juicy taste of guava with the tangy, bittersweet flavour of passion fruit. Paired with a splash of the bright, tropical taste of pineapple. The result is a deliciously exotic Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple vape juice that’s perfect for anyone looking for a taste of the Caribbean. Order the Punk Guava Passion Fruit and Pineapple by Riot Squad today to treat your taste buds to a tropical holiday with every puff!
